correctness.rationale: For odd n curvature radius rho=w(1+sgn(cos ntheta))/2 gives only odd-n multiple harmonics; support Fourier coefficients decay as 1/[j(n²j²-1)], and Parseval area deficit is positive weighted square of 3-phase Fourier sums. The odd-harmonic pair kernel F_n(t)=sum cos(jt)/[j²(n²j²-1)] has the exact closed expression on [0,pi], and derivative pi/4*(1-cos((pi/2-t)/n)/cos(pi/(2n)))<0 inside (0,pi). A three circular-gap minimizer cannot have a gap >=pi; equal derivative for three interior gaps forces equal gaps, and all collision boundaries are strictly worse by sin(3s)<3sin(s). The maximum deficit is positive because modes j divisible by 3 survive. Taylor expansion F_n(2pi/3)>0 gives the stated local stability. Independently summed Fourier series and closed kernel for n=3,5,9,19, checked exact deficit and a 61x61 phase grid, finding only expected equal-spaced phase pairs on grid; finite mesh corroborates rather than proves global rigidity.
